title: Super no Ura de Yani Suu Futari

thread.title: Smoking Behind the Supermarket with You • Super no Ura de Yani Suu Futari - Episode 12 discussion - FINAL

opinions.point: The finale was widely viewed as warm, relaxing, funny, and emotionally satisfying, with many readers hoping for another season.
Commenters especially praised the central relationship, describing the characters as mutually supportive and compelling even without explicit romantic progression.
Several people enjoyed the deliberately gradual relationship development, while others felt the romance or deeper character threads progressed too slowly.
The adaptation was praised for its cozy atmosphere, visual charm, comedic timing, and ability to make quiet conversations engaging.
Voice performances, especially the contrasting delivery of Yamada and Tayama, were repeatedly highlighted as a major strength.
One commenter strongly disliked the show's favorable portrayal of smoking, despite still enjoying the characters and overall series.
